questions.answer: Not successful. I wanted to study microbiology, but ended up studying philosophy, because I was not allowed to take courses in two different faculties.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Get in touch with the supervisor of the course or the faculty directly and ask them whether or not you can take a course. The process of registering to courses through the international student adviser and coordinator was very complicated and difficult. At one time I was told by the Senior international adviser at my host university, that I could not go on exchange because it would not be possible for me to take the courses I wanted to. This was very stressful. I then e-mailed the supervisor of the faculty directly and this person signed my learning agreement and I was able to go on exchange.
